description:
Update the UI's data layer to the new step-record location and
the new conversation-detection signal. Frontend rendering of
streaming text (bl-0619) and pulse indicators (bl-23d9) layer on
top after this lands.

=== Scope ===

1. fs_watcher target update. The watcher already watches conv-repo
   control-plane paths plus per-worktree contents; add
   <conv-repo>/steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/ to the watched set.
   Drop the prior worktree-side steps/<conv-id>/ pattern.

2. git_tree conversation detection. Currently keys off
   'steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/...' paths in --no-ff merge commit
   diffs. After P2 those paths no longer appear in any commit.
   Switch detection to the merged branch's name — it already
   encodes the conv-id as a hyphenated descent (§2.3), and
   'git log --no-ff --first-parent main' surfaces the merge
   commits with their --no-ff branch labels.

3. View-model updates. ConversationBranch + step enumeration read
   the new path under <conv-repo>/steps/<conv-id>/. Rendering API
   stays the same.

4. Test fixtures. The hand-constructed conv-repo fixtures under
   crates/lernie-ui-egui/src/git_tree/tests/ are rebuilt to the
   new shape. Render and parse tests cover both merged-trunk and
   in-flight enumeration paths.

=== Out of scope ===

- Streaming-text widget rendering — that's bl-0619 (UI live
  streaming text), which gains a hard dep on this P4.
- Pulse indicators — bl-23d9 gains a hard dep on this P4 since
  pulse detection looks under tools/<tool-id>/ which moves.
- Branch-state badges (bl-de6b) and user-action triggers
  (bl-163d) don't directly depend on step paths.

=== Gates ===

Tests, docs, alignment per AGENTS.md.
title: v0.3.1 P4: UI fs_watcher target + git_tree conversation detection update
